analysis: This PR changes only docs/reference/protocol-messages.md: the date bump (line 3) and, in the changed range around lines 1147-1155, a reasoning-control row that describes GLM-5 prompt policy handling of `reasoning: null`, `reasoning.summary` and `reasoning.generate_summary`. The supplied units cover lines 1-325 and 326-581 of the head file, which do not include the changed lines. The patch excerpt is truncated, so I could not check the changed table row against the implementation. I reviewed the unchanged surrounding text for context. It describes the App Attest endpoint-resume candidate (fresh per-socket nonce, 4 KiB strict wire validation, a single reply on the originating socket, no local trust and no extension of proof lifetime), the drain barrier, and the diagnostics that are excluded from the signed transcript and cannot authorize serving. These match the T-053 and TB-011 intent and the threat-model comments. No code, wire fields, crypto, authorization or storage behavior change. The documented new input handling (null `reasoning` treated as unset, summary values accepted as no-ops, other `reasoning` members refused) affects prompt-rendering behavior in GLM5NextPromptPolicy.swift. That source was not supplied, so whether the implementation matches this text is unverified. A mismatch would be a doc-accuracy concern and not an exploitable regression in the supplied evidence. I found nothing that touches the prefix-cache threat T-041, A-003 key custody, or the TB-002 coordinator-to-provider boundary. Remaining question for integration: confirm that GLM5NextPromptPolicy.swift rejects unknown `reasoning` members and invalid effort values, as documented.
